name.note: FlightFX Hawker 800XP manual, specification page. Catalog name is the sim add-on.

cruiseKt.note: Max cruise 447–449 KTAS. Manual specification page. Stored as 447.

longRangeCruiseKt.note: Long-range cruise table, 22,000 lb, FL390 and FL410, ISA.

rangeNm.note: NBAA IFR range. Manual specification page.

ferryRangeNm.note: Not stated as a single ferry figure in the manual.

fuelBurnLbHr.note: High-speed cruise, 22,000 lb, FL370, ISA, 447 KTAS. Manual cruise table. Stored in pounds per hour.

maxFuelLb.note: Spec table 10,000 lb. Manual specification page. Fuel is stored in pounds.

fuelDensityLbPerGal.note: Derived from the EFB screen: 9,692 lb = 1,447 US gal. Not stated in the manual.

mrwLb.note: Max ramp weight. Manual specification page.

oewLb.note: Blank for user entry. Operating empty weight is not filled from the manual.

crewSeats.note: Two pilots. Manual weight and balance page.

takeoffDistanceFt.note: Flaps 15, sea level, 15 °C, 28,000 lb, dry. Manual takeoff table.

landingDistanceFt.note: Factored landing field length, flaps 45, sea level, dry, 23,350 lb. Manual landing table.

remarks.value: FlightFX Hawker 800XP (no winglets). Not 850XP, XP2, or XPR.
remarks.note: docs/HAWKER_800XP.md. The sim add-on is the non-winglet baseline.

maintenance.label: B / C / D check (400 h)
maintenance.note: AMS hourly check. hawker800xp.ts hourlyCheckHours and docs/HAWKER_800XP.md. No mandatory 50 h inspection.

maintenance.label: E check
maintenance.note: AMS calendar, 12 months. Hour figure is 400 h/year from hawker800xp.ts, not a separate OEM hour limit. docs/HAWKER_800XP.md.

maintenance.label: F check
maintenance.note: AMS calendar, 24 months. Hour figure is 400 h/year from hawker800xp.ts. docs/HAWKER_800XP.md.

maintenance.label: G check
maintenance.note: AMS calendar, 48 months. Hour figure is 400 h/year from hawker800xp.ts. docs/HAWKER_800XP.md.

maintenance.label: Landing gear overhaul
maintenance.note: AMS calendar, 144 months. Hour figure is 400 h/year from hawker800xp.ts. docs/HAWKER_800XP.md.

maintenance.label: MPI
maintenance.note: MPI interval. Manual maintenance page. aircraftBase.json.

maintenance.label: CZI
maintenance.note: CZI interval. Manual maintenance page. aircraftBase.json.
